name: 62557 · Pana, IL
findings: ZIP 62557 (Pana) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62557 (Pana) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62557 (Pana) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).
